readerc_cells_not_run: Code cells were not run. Turn on Run code in the LibrePaper desktop app to include their results.
readerc_comments_export_failed: The comments could not be exported.
readerc_template_save_failed: The template could not be saved.
readerc_preview_no_own: {name} has no preview of its own.
readerc_preview_part_latex: {name} has no {cmd}, so it is part of a larger document.
readerc_preview_part: {name} is part of a larger document.
readerc_insertion_changed: The document or selected text changed. Close this dialog and choose the insertion point again.
readerc_download_no_files: This project has no files to download.
readerc_download_project_failed: The project could not be downloaded.
readerc_download_entry_failed: That file could not be downloaded.
readerc_local_storage_failed: {error}. This browser can no longer keep its own copy of the project, so a reload while the connection is down would lose what is not yet on the server. Download the project to have a copy that does not depend on either.
readerc_no_renderer: A {format} document is read where its renderer is built, and this browser has none for it.
readerc_doc_missing_sign_in: No document at this address. If it was shared with you, sign in: a document shared with an account opens only for that account.
readerc_doc_missing: No document at this address. The link may be wrong, or the document may have been deleted.
readerc_server_open_failed: The server could not open this document (error {status}). Reload the page to try again.
readerc_server_unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection, then reload the page.
readerc_offline_pending: Offline. Your latest changes are in this browser only, and will be sent as soon as the connection returns.
readerc_offline_saved: Offline. Everything typed so far has already reached the server.
readerc_too_large: This document is too large to render right now. It stays unreadable here until its editors bring it back under the limit; they can still type and export locally in the meantime.
readerc_project_load_failed: The current project could not be loaded.
readerc_demo_no_uploads: Images and other uploads are not available in the demo.
